statusHistory.note: Allocated for UNOWNED-001. The identifier was recomputed against every remote branch as well as this worktree rather than assumed to be the next number: that check found SPEC-0007 allocated twice - client-demo-data-personas-reset here and lead-delete-affordance on origin/fix/p0-lead-delete-affordance - which is registered separately and does not affect this allocation. SPEC-0009 is free everywhere.

Five ambiguities raised. Three answered from advisory and registry metadata: the next target is 16.3.4 not 16.3.3 because 16.3.3 declares sharp ^0.35.3 and readmits the vulnerable version; nodemailer needs no package.json change because ^9.0.4 already admits the fixed 9.1.1; sharp is not a direct dependency and its version is decided by an existing overrides entry that already admits the fix. Two are open with recommendations: whether to tighten the sharp override, and whether to add dependency watching, which is recommended as a separate change rather than absorbed here.

Classified R4 against docs/RISK_CLASSIFICATION.md by blast radius, and against docs/sdd/BUG_WORKFLOW.md, which puts any bug with a security dimension at R4 or above with Application Security involved from the report. The change is a framework minor upgrade motivated by two unauthenticated RCE advisories, on the code path that carries every authenticated request. Not R5: no infrastructure file, no workflow, no environment variable in a deployed environment, nothing run against production.

AD-001 to AD-006 recorded against measured evidence rather than against npm audit's suggestion. Expected diff bounded and verified by dry run before approval: 7 lockfile entries changed, 0 added, 0 removed, and one mandatory package.json line. Schema and migration impact NONE.

Artefact set complete for R4. Stops here. Gates 1, 3 and 5 are UNRESOLVED and no dependency has been changed. The only command run against the tree was a dry run, which wrote nothing - confirmed by a clean git status on both manifests afterwards. TASK-001, the read-only baseline, is the only task that may run before approval.

Revision 2 begins. TASK-001 executed read-only; its first command found origin/fix/dependency-advisories-2026-09, pull request 48, already carrying the three-package remediation - CI run 34350379563 concluded success, and the same work merged into rc/incident-2026-09-09 passes the full gate including E2E on run 34366512152. The UNOWNED-001 classification was made from a stale remote view and was wrong; registered as EVC-022. Returned to CLARIFYING because the premise of the specification no longer held and CL-006 was raised: whether the narrowed change is still R4.

Human scope decision recorded: narrow to the sharp override floor alone. The next, nodemailer and sharp upgrades are attributed to pull request 48 and are not reimplemented. CL-003 resolved by the human as an Application Security decision - tighten overrides.sharp from ^0.35.0 to ^0.35.4. CL-004 resolved and found empty: the 48 graph reports 0 critical, 0 high, 0 moderate, 0 low in production. Risk reassessed rather than retained automatically and kept at R4 on new grounds, recorded as CL-006 and left open for the Solution Architect: the narrowed change touches no surface the R4 row of docs/RISK_CLASSIFICATION.md enumerates, but its entire content is the threshold of a security control, and reclassifying to R2 would let the agent that proposed the floor also self-check it.

AD-007 to AD-010 recorded against measurement rather than assertion: an overrides entry replaces the parent declared range, proven by forcing overrides.sharp to 0.35.3 under next 16.3.4 and observing sharp resolve to 0.35.3 with 2 high, against zero at ^0.35.4. Expected diff is one package.json line, a lockfile overrides mirror or nothing, and three new tests. ST-007 added because on the current graph every other test passes identically before and after, so without it the change would ship with no evidence it does anything. Schema and migration impact NONE.

Artefact set complete for the narrowed R4 scope. Gates 1, 3 and 5 UNRESOLVED. No manifest has been modified; apps/web/package.json and apps/web/package-lock.json are unchanged from HEAD. TASK-002 additionally requires pull request 48 integrated into dev/yourhan-next first, because against a tree where sharp is still 0.35.3 this change would force an upgrade rather than hold one.
